# La Suite Drive

> Open source file storage and sharing, self-hostable under MIT. Drive stores
> files in an S3 bucket, shares them with people and links, opens office files
> in Collabora or OnlyOffice, and signs users in through OpenID Connect.

## Using Drive

- [Getting started](user/getting-started.md): sign in, add, open and act on files
- [Sharing](user/sharing.md): people, roles and links
- [Finding and organising files](user/organising.md): search, move, trash
